1.e4 e6 2.f4 d5 3.Nf3.strategy: Develops, but leaves e4 to its fate: after the capture the pawn on e4 attacks the knight, so White loses time as well as a pawn. A knight outpost on e5 backed by the f-pawn and some activity are thin compensation.

1.e4 e6 2.f4 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4.strategy: Takes the pawn White left hanging, with a gain of time because the pawn attacks the knight. Black has to finish development safely and keep the extra material; White's only compensation is activity, not structure.
1.e4 e6 2.f4 d5 3.Nf3 dxe4.name: French Defence: La Bourdonnais Variation, Reuter Gambit
